schema_transition.evidence: Reviewed single-step transition from the installed through-020 lineage (020 applied 2026-10-27, apply run 40551173291) to through-020-021, preserving installed order and byte hashes under the exact-prefix gate. Pending set: [021]. Migration 021 owns its BEGIN/COMMIT and its ledger row commits atomically. The 2026-10-28 one_percent purge rehearsal (run 40571954621) passed its own checks but extrapolated two verifications and the Search index build beyond the 7,200 s envelope. 019's verification re-read each chunk with row comparisons led by derived_generation_id plus a separate equality, so each chunk's index scan ran to the end of the survivor generation; 021's purge_copy_verify re-reads each chunk the way purge_copy_chunk read it (low key, primary-key order, LIMIT the ledgered rows). 021's purge_copy_prepare creates the live GiST indexes on the empty staging table so the bounded chunk inserts fill them, and purge_copy_build_indexes leaves only such an exactly-matching GiST index alone. Otherwise 019's checks, settings, owners and grants. Installation copies, swaps, drops and deletes no payload row and changes no table, view, grant or ledger row. scripts/operator/v3_schema_identity.py reproduces installed checksum 55284f7de874b3b895e2e8415112ba7dbc2b250e200f482d68cba23506111f00 and target checksum c54f861f1dfac64cad9e543da47fe709492c2ad1f468f86f44dd706fa1d40679 with migration-set identity sha256:931f8d06edef15c79d79f537aa63c4131fe4e5f49add904383cfc3428ad33edf. Accepted a031c2da and its rollback targets are compatible with both endpoints. 021 must be applied before the purge plan and authorize, because 016 freezes a hash of the applied-migrations ledger and the purge controller requires the live ledger to equal the committed manifest. Registration only: exact-head acceptance, a reviewed governed plan and a separate apply remain required.
